answer: What survives to the velvet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the inlet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vertex re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
